'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)]]
**[[War crimes in the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)]]
***The [[United Nations]] reports that [[Russia]]n authorities subject [[Civilian internee|civilian detainees]] in [[Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine|occupied Ukrainian territories]] to widespread torture, including [[Wartime sexual violence|sexual violence]], while also documenting cases of ill-treatment of detainees held by [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] authorities. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/un-slams-systematic-russian-torture-ukraine-civilians-5364106 (AFP via CNA)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Mexico–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] [[Repatriation (cultural property)|repatriates]] a centuries-old [[Spanish colonization of the Americas|Spanish colonial]] map depicting the [[Camino Real de Tierra Adentro]] to [[Mexico]]'s [[Secretariat of Culture]] after being recovered in [[Santa Fe, New Mexico|Santa Fe]], [[New Mexico]]. [https://apnews.com/article/spanish-colonial-map-mexico-history-b13db985c97a3a3f11285d94008bd22c (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economy of New Zealand]]
**[[New Zealand]] introduces two new [[New Zealand permanent residency|residency pathways]] for [[skilled worker]]s and tradespeople to address labor shortages. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/new-zealand-loosens-path-residency-some-migrants-2025-09-22/ (Reuters)]
*[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] announces that it will close all 19 of its [[Amazon Fresh]] stores in the [[United Kingdom]] after "a thorough evaluation of its business operations". [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2xnkkn9ywo (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Ragasa]]
***At least 14 people are killed and 124 others are missing after a [[Landslide dam|barrier lake]] in [[Hualien County]], [[Taiwan]], bursts during Ragasa, causing widespread flooding. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/sep/24/super-typhoon-ragasa-update-path-hong-kong-taiwan-china (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
***[[Hong Kong International Airport]] suspends all passenger flights for 36 hours as Ragasa approaches. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-09-22/hong-kong-airport-weighs-36-hour-closure-as-super-typhoon-nears (Bloomberg News)] [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/east-asia/hong-kong-airport-shut-36-hours-typhoon-ragasa-sia-singapore-airlines-5361291 (CNA)]
*[[September 2025 Kolkata cloudburst]]
**At least 12 people are killed during [[flash flood]]ing in [[Kolkata]], [[West Bengal]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/least-12-dead-record-rain-floods-indias-kolkata-2025-09-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Aquidauana Cessna 175 crash]]
**Four people, including [[Chinese people|Chinese]] architect [[Kongjian Yu]], are killed when a [[Cessna 175 Skylark]] aircraft crashes in [[Aquidauana]], [[Mato Grosso do Sul]], [[Brazil]]. [https://www.campograndenews.com.br/cidades/interior/aviao-de-pequeno-porte-cai-em-fazenda-no-pantanal-de-ms (Campo Grande News)] [https://g1.globo.com/ms/mato-grosso-do-sul/noticia/2025/09/24/vitimas-do-acidente-de-aviao-no-pantanal-no-ms.ghtml (G1)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/chinese-architect-kongjian-yu-dies-plane-crash-brazil-local-media-reports-2025-09-24/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Deportation in the second Trump administration]], [[Foreign relations of Ghana]]
**Eleven [[West Africa]]n migrants deported from the [[United States]] to [[Ghana]] are subsequently sent to their home countries despite ongoing legal proceedings and concerns about potential persecution. [https://apnews.com/article/ghana-us-west-african-migrants-deported-0e8ff2aa79ba5ae87888853c223d99a4 (AP)]
*[[Indonesia–European Union relations]]
**[[Indonesia]] and the [[European Union]] sign a [[free trade agreement]] in [[Bali]] after over nine years of negotiations that will remove [[tariff]]s on bilateral trade while also opening investments in other sectors. [https://www.dw.com/en/eu-indonesia-agree-on-free-trade-deal/a-74103321 (DW)]
*[[Violations of non-combatant airspaces during the Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)]]
**[[Lithuania]]'s [[Seimas|parliament]] authorizes [[Lithuanian Armed Forces|its military]] to shoot down any unauthorized drones in its [[airspace]] following recent [[Russia]]n drones entering the country. Previously, only drones deemed armed or posing an imminent threat to critical state assets could be targeted. [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/lithuania-authorises-army-shoot-down-drones-violating-its-airspace-2025-09-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[China]] announces it will no longer claim [[General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade#Special and differential treatment|special and differential treatment]] benefits under current and future [[World Trade Organization]] agreements. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/china-forego-special-differential-treatment-future-wto-negotiations-2025-09-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Crime in Norway]]
**Grenades are thrown and explode in [[Bislett]] in central [[Oslo]], [[Norway]]. Three young minors are arrested shortly after, the [[Norwegian Police]] suspects the attack was made on behalf of the Swedish [[Foxtrot (criminal network)]]. [https://www.thelocal.no/20250924/norwegian-police-detain-three-boys-over-oslo-grenade-attack (The Local)]
*[[2025 British anti-immigration protests]]
**An [[England and Wales|English]] [[Magistrates' court (England and Wales)|magistrates' court]] sentences an [[Ethiopians in the United Kingdom|Ethiopian]] [[Asylum seeker|asylum-seeker]] to 12 months in prison for [[sexually assaulting]] a woman and a 14-year-old girl, an incident that triggered nationwide protests over [[Modern immigration to the United Kingdom|migration policies]] and the housing of asylum-seekers in hotels. [https://apnews.com/article/uk-asylum-seeker-sentenced-kebatu-epping-2e7ad640c15b74fcb65c159b4fc110ee (AP)]
*[[Flood control projects controversy in the Philippines]]
**The [[Philippine]] [[Department of Justice (Philippines)|Department of Justice]] and the [[National Bureau of Investigation (Philippines)|National Bureau of Investigation]] file criminal [[Graft (politics)|graft]] and [[malversation]] charges against [[Senate of the Philippines|senators]] [[Jinggoy Estrada]] and [[Joel Villanueva]], [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|representative]] [[Zaldy Co]], former representative [[Mitch Cajayon-Uy]], and two former [[Department of Public Works and Highways|public works]] officials in connection with investigations into alleged [[Corruption in the Philippines|corruption]] in [[flood control]] projects with the [[Anti–Money Laundering Council]] [[Asset freezing|freezing their assets]]. [https://gulfnews.com/world/asia/philippines/philippines-asset-freeze-of-senators-estrada-villanueva-rep-co-other-officials-ordered-freeze-of-romualdezs-asset-sought-1.500272428 (''Gulf News'')] [https://www.rappler.com/philippines/video-nbi-complaint-estrada-villanueva-co-cajayon-uy/ (Rappler)]
*[[Jaguar Land Rover cyberattack]]
**[[Automotive industry in the United Kingdom|British]] [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[Automotive industry|car-maker]] [[Jaguar Land Rover]] announces the pause in vehicle production due to a [[cyberattack]] is to be extended until 1 October. [https://www.irishtimes.com/business/2025/09/23/jaguar-land-rover-cyberattack-shutdown-to-hit-four-weeks/ (''The Irish Times'')]
*[[Italy]]'s [[Guardia di Finanza]] arrests five people and seizes [[Euro|€]]17 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]20 million) while dismantling a [[Syria]]n-led network that [[Money laundering|laundered]] [[Illegal drug trade|drug-trafficking]] proceeds in [[France]] and Italy by [[Gold as an investment|converting cash into gold]], in an investigation coordinated with the [[National Gendarmerie]], [[Eurojust]], and [[Europol]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/italy-dismantles-syrian-network-accused-turning-drug-cash-into-gold-2025-09-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Singapore]]-based [[shipping line]] [[X-Press Feeders]] refuses to pay the US$1 billion in [[damages]] ordered by [[Sri Lanka]]'s [[Supreme Court of Sri Lanka|Supreme Court]] over [[pollution]] caused by the 2021 sinking of the ''[[X-Press Pearl]]'', arguing the ruling violates [[Convention on Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims|international maritime liability conventions]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20250922-singapore-firm-rejects-1bn-sri-lankan-pollution-damages (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Trinidad and Tobago]]'s [[Supreme Court of Judicature (Trinidad and Tobago)|high court]] blocks the [[extradition]] of former [[FIFA]] vice president [[Jack Warner (football executive)|Jack Warner]] to the [[United States]], ruling that proceedings were invalid without a formal extradition treaty. [https://apnews.com/article/jack-warner-trinidad-us-extradition-court-judge-623782c790957808f438186f10edbd50 (AP)]
*[[Unification Church]] leader [[Hak Ja Han]] is arrested in [[Seoul]], [[South Korea]], as prosecutors investigate allegations that the church bribed former [[First Lady of South Korea|first lady]] [[Kim Keon Hee]] and [[National Assembly (South Korea)|lawmaker]] [[Kweon Seong-dong]], both of whom face separate [[Corruption in South Korea|corruption]] charges. [https://apnews.com/article/arrest-warrant-unification-church-hak-ja-han-a94265a743ff76f860f1b5df9f6bed3f (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Gaza war protests]]
**[[September 2025 Italian general strike for Gaza]]
***Thousands of people across [[Italy]] hold rallies and a [[general strike]] to protest against the [[Israeli occupation of the Gaza Strip|Israeli occupation]] of the [[Gaza Strip]] and recent [[2025 Gaza City offensive|ground offensive]] into [[Gaza City]]. [[Dock worker]]s at ports in [[Genoa]], [[Livorno]], [[Trieste]], and [[Venice]] hold strikes, while protesters clash with [[Law enforcement in Italy|police]] in [[Milan]] and 20,000 people march in [[Rome]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/italy-thousands-join-pro-palestinian-protests-strikes/a-74100712 (DW)] [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2025/09/23/in-italy-tens-of-thousands-stage-protests-in-solidarity-with-gaza_6745649_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
*[[2025 Malawian general election]]
**Former [[Malawi]]an [[President of Malawi|president]] [[Peter Mutharika]] is projected to win the 2025 presidential election with more than 56% of the vote, according to unofficial tallies, while official results from the [[Malawi Electoral Commission|electoral commission]] show him leading incumbent [[Lazarus Chakwera]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/malawis-times-tv-projects-ex-president-mutharika-will-win-presidential-election-2025-09-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[2026 Ugandan general election]]
**[[Uganda]]'s [[Electoral Commission of Uganda|Electoral Commission]] clears [[President of Uganda|President]] [[Yoweri Museveni]] to run for reelection in 2026, a move that could extend his rule to nearly 50 years. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/ugandas-museveni-cleared-seek-reelection-eyes-near-half-century-rule-2025-09-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*Scientists in [[Argentina]] identify a new [[Megaraptora|megaraptoran]] species, ''[[Joaquinraptor casali]]'', from fossils in [[Patagonia]], providing one of the most complete skeletons of its group. [https://apnews.com/article/new-dinosaur-megaraptoran-argentina-patagonia-4246f7559e4d7ee2dcde23dc2afcf0ad (AP)]
